children: Bengaluru-based identity and access management startup OTPless has elevated co-founders Satyam Nathani and Tanmay Sagar to chief executive officer and chief operating officer, respectively, as the company enters its next phase of growth.

The leadership elevation comes as OTPless scales its platform, which now serves more than 300 million users and has reached Rs 36 crore in annualised revenue, a 2.5X increase from the previous year, according to the company.
The 12-member startup has also remained profitable for the past two quarters, the company said.

Nathani and Sagar founded OTPless in 2023. Before launching the startup, both had dropped out of IIT Delhi and joined BharatPe as founding members, contributing to the fintech company’s early growth and its eventual transition into a unicorn.

OTPless provides authentication and identity solutions for consumer businesses through technologies including Silent Network Authentication, WhatsApp Authentication, Device Intelligence and Passkeys. Its platform currently authenticates more than 300 million mobile users and counts Meesho, Navi, PhysicsWallah, ShareChat, Shiprocket, ixigo and Zepto among its customers.
